get.description: Compare two domains' organic rankings in one call. Returns keywords where one domain outranks the other or has just overtaken it, with both sites' ranks, changes, clicks, and URLs. The comparison domain's metrics appear in the your* fields. Choose the mode with keywordSearchType.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Primary domain to analyze. This domain's ranking data appears in the main response fields (rank, rankChange, seoClicks, etc.). Accepts full domains (example.com), complete URLs, subdomains, or specific paths.

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: Required. Chooses the ranking scenario for the query/compareDomain pair and governs how results are interpreted. TheyOutrankYou: keywords where query ranks above compareDomain. TheyJustSurpassedYou: recent crossovers where query moved ahead.

x-enum-descriptions.TheyOutrankYou: Keywords where the query domain ranks higher than compareDomain now. To see where a competitor outranks you, put competitor in query and your site in compareDomain.
x-enum-descriptions.TheyJustSurpassedYou: Keywords where the query domain recently overtook compareDomain in rank. Highlights fresh shifts. To see where a competitor just passed you, put competitor in query and your site in compareDomain.

parameters.name: compareDomain
parameters.description: Domain to compare against. This domain's ranking data appears in the 'your' response fields (yourRank, yourRankChange, yourUrl). The endpoint shows where the query domain currently outranks this comparison domain.

parameters.name: includeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

parameters.name: includeAnyTerm
parameters.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

parameters.name: excludeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

parameters.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
parameters.description: If true, exclude keywords where the query domain's homepage (root domain, e.g., example.com) ranks; if false, include all.

parameters.name: searchVolume.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: searchVolume.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≥ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≤ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: rank.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the query domain's rank position is ≥ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

parameters.name: rank.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the query domain's rank position is ≤ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

parameters.name: rankChange.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the query domain improved by at least this many positions vs. the previous month (rank_change ≥ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

parameters.name: rankChange.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the query domain's month-over-month rank change is at most this many positions (rank_change ≤ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

parameters.name: costPerClick.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: costPerClick.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: costPerClickOption
parameters.description: Match type for CPC filtering. Broad = includes variations/related terms; Exact = exact keyword only; Phrase = contains the keyword phrase in order (with additional words allowed).

x-enumDescriptions.Broad: Includes keyword variations and related terms
x-enumDescriptions.Phrase: Includes the keyword phrase in order with additional words

x-enumDescriptions.ExactCostPerClick: Average amount advertisers pay per click for exact match ads on this keyword

x-enumDescriptions.TotalMonthlyClicks: Total estimated clicks made on this SERP to any paid or organic results

get.description: Returns top organic pages for a domain, subdomain, path, or full URL. Use searchType to choose: MostTraffic (highest estimated SEO clicks) or New (newly gaining traffic). Results include page URL and monthly SEO clicks; optional keywordFilter narrows by ranked keywords.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Domain or URL to analyze. Accepts full domains (example.com), complete URLs (https://example.com/blog), subdomains (blog.example.com), or specific paths (example.com/products/).

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: Required. Selects page analysis type: MostTraffic=pages generating most organic traffic overall, New=pages recently discovered with significant traffic. Determines whether to return established top performers or emerging high-traffic pages.

x-enum-descriptions.MostTraffic: Returns pages with highest organic traffic for the query domain/path. Identifies top-performing content by estimated monthly organic clicks. Shows which pages drive most SEO value and traffic to the site.
x-enum-descriptions.New: Returns pages recently discovered generating significant organic traffic for the query domain/path. Identifies newly successful content and emerging pages. Reveals fresh opportunities and content strategies driving recent SEO growth.

parameters.name: keywordFilter
parameters.description: Filter to pages that rank for keywords containing this term. Helps narrow results to specific topics or content themes.

parameters.name: seoClicks.min
parameters.description: Filter to pages where estimated monthly organic clicks are ≥ this value.

parameters.name: seoClicks.max
parameters.description: Filter to pages where estimated monthly organic clicks are ≤ this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google version to query against (google.de for Germany, etc).  Google.com (US) is the default.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to sort by.

x-enumDescriptions.SeoClicks: Estimated monthly organic clicks that each new page receives from all of its keyword rankings

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Order to sort the results.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Row number to start the results with.

get.description: Performs 5 types of keyword research via keywordSearchType parameter: PhraseMatch (thematic similarities), Questions (interrogative queries), AlsoBuysAdsFor (co-targeted PPC terms), AlsoRanksFor (co-ranking SEO terms), Transactions (commercial intent). Set keywordSearchType to select method.

parameters.description: The keyword to query for.

parameters.name: keywordSearchType
parameters.description: Required. Selects keyword research method: PhraseMatch=thematically related, Questions=interrogative forms, AlsoBuysAdsFor=keywords co-targeted in ads, AlsoRanksFor=keywords co-ranking organically, Transactions=purchase-intent keywords. Each returns different keyword relationships.

x-enum-descriptions.AlsoBuysAdsFor: Returns keywords that advertisers commonly target together with the query keyword in PPC campaigns. Analyzes co-targeting patterns in paid search advertising.
x-enum-descriptions.AlsoRanksFor: Returns keywords that websites ranking for the query keyword also rank for organically. Analyzes co-ranking patterns in organic search results.
x-enum-descriptions.PhraseMatch: Returns keywords thematically and semantically related to the query keyword. Finds terms with similar meaning, context, or category associations.
x-enum-descriptions.Questions: Returns question-format keywords related to the query topic. Includes who, what, when, where, why, how queries that users search.
x-enum-descriptions.Transactions: Returns keywords with commercial/transactional intent related to the query. Identifies buying-signal terms like buy, price, deal, discount, review.
